payload.title: File:Akharhynchus (holotype rostrum - 3D scan).jpg
payload.artist_html: M. L. Jacobs, R. E. Smith & S. Zouhri
payload.credit_html: "A new ornithocheirid pterosaur (Pterosauria: Ornithocheiridae) from the mid-Cretaceous Ifezouane Formation, Kem Kem Group of Morocco"
payload.description_html: Topographic scan images of the holotype rostrum of Akharhynchus martilli gen. et sp. nov. FSAC-KK-12500 from the Kem Kem Group of Morocco. A, anterior view; B, posterior view; C, dorsal view; D, ventral view; E, left lateral view; F, right lateral view. Scale bar = 10 mm.
